source_binding: Resolve this manifest at the selected commit and verify referenced blob identities.

features.title: GitHub repository context and source lookup
invariants: Bind source ranges to the selected repository commit and blob.
Keep repository references, historical observations and personal documents distinct.
Graph edges and tests are candidates until verified.

features.title: Conversation privacy and AI profile selection
invariants: Saved private-chat authority follows its conversation and queued work independently of global availability.
Profile selection is distinct from dispatch authorization.
Protected display ranges require content-bound masking evidence.
Final outbound privacy receipts contain counts, revisions and request-keyed fingerprints, never originals or replacement maps.
Private plain-text replies restore incrementally; local tool control remains separately validated.
Diagnostic content defaults to redacted; full forensic consent and resume identity are separate.
Synthetic local checks report measured privacy, intent and timing scope without claiming cloud quality or accelerator execution.
Masked fallback publication revalidates captured provider and retained-source authority before each output; revoked authority preserves partial failure and never replays output.
Ordinary modal collisions require positive detector classification and exact request-local copied-span provenance; protected overlaps and all other known-value checks remain authoritative.

Private stream events are revalidated after the channel handoff under captured conversation authority; denial stops upstream before one content-free partial failure, preserves cancellation and caller context, and never grants an error-code bypass.

A receiving-side denial carries generation_completed only from an actual observed Completed event; final accounting retains that content-free fact separately from failed delivery, transport completion and replay permission, never from upstream failure metadata.

An explicit provider comparison accepts only closed fictional fixtures, preserves the actual private dispatch/restoration and live authority checks, excludes saved personal text and tools, and keeps observed detection, task criteria, usage and timing separate. Only completed pairs with matching observed runtime/output ceilings enter grouped nearest-rank sample percentiles; warmups, incomplete or mismatched pairs and unverified strict-route settings are excluded.

Cancel the fictional provider comparison when its screen lifecycle stops or its composition is disposed; retain recorded and partial results, wait for provider cleanup, and require an explicit new Run after resuming.

Cancellation during a suspended non-null configured provider-authority check propagates unchanged at opening and pre-dispatch collection, retires owning and validating work, restores caller context and opens no provider in either comparison protection mode.

features.title: Voice playback, captions and speech benchmarks
invariants: Presented audio and reply identity own caption position.
Synthesis completion does not imply playback completion.
Physical acceleration and latency require device measurements.
Plan complete utterances within native bounds and distinguish current execution, profile availability and qualified comparisons.
Retain exact workload, voice, rate, source and thermal identity; playback measurements do not establish acoustic latency or battery benefits.
Keep native progress polling separate from synthesis-owned evidence and retain audio/model ownership until actual retirement.
Playback comparison requires the current controlled workload protocol, independent fixture coverage and observed provider execution.
Benchmark and Auto ranking require same-run CPU-reference duration, token timing and signal consistency; numeric consistency does not establish perceptual equivalence.
Retain at most two exact accelerator token shapes under observed memory headroom and a hard estimate ceiling; unknown memory retains only the active shape.
One playback-scoped quiet limiter spans streaming callbacks and phrases; validate raw PCM first and account only retained audio in queued frames and cue positions.

An observed cue prefix may extend in place; a fully trimmed ending clears only the current presented word during refill, without advancing the caption clock, consuming a later onset or bypassing audio-focus pause.

Streaming reserve learning uses retained-PCM delivery gaps before phrase completion, excludes callback and bounded-queue waits, preserves an active-stream maximum and eight completed-stream maxima, and keeps whole-phrase ratio/word-cost accounting separate. Existing reserve, queue, caption, pause and cancellation bounds remain authoritative; synthetic tests do not establish acoustic continuity on a target phone.

features.title: Streaming speech engines, preparation and playback admission
invariants: Stream PCM with bounded backpressure and retire native handles before releasing model leases.
SDK estimated word cues and requested delegates must not become native timing or executed-processor proof.
Only explicit model installation may download a speech pack; private conversations cannot send speech to Gateway.
Preserve original source ranges and pronunciation overrides when bounding long streaming replies.

Production accelerator playback requires complete same-run CPU-reference consistency before native open; explicit Recheck publishes its complete requested cohort and cancellation cannot grant partial admission.
Numerical audio consistency and SDK model smoke do not establish perceptual equivalence, arbitrary-utterance correctness or target-phone accelerator performance.

Gateway response retirement is bound to the exact admitted Work lease; cancellation and a fixed timeout plus validated audio duration bound transport without extending synthesis or retiring a replacement request.

Streaming reserve learning uses retained-PCM delivery gaps before phrase completion, excludes callback and bounded-queue waits, preserves an active-stream maximum and eight completed-stream maxima, and keeps whole-phrase ratio/word-cost accounting separate. Existing reserve, queue, caption, pause and cancellation bounds remain authoritative; synthetic tests do not establish acoustic continuity on a target phone.

features.title: GitHub editing, task continuation and validation
invariants: Reconcile uncertain writes before replaying a mutation.
Publication requires current source and applicable verification.
Workers cannot grant controller or mutation authority.
Settle interrupted phone-index work only after exact local ownership and unwind evidence; preserve unrelated unknown remote operations.
Argument canonicalization is separate from semantic repair and its observed execution outcome.
A native saved-page read and proven provider delivery are separate facts; continuation retains original context, output and attempt limits.
Fixture mutation authority comes from the accepted task policy; general tool auto approval does not grant it.

Every native-admitted unconsumed saved page receives bounded final-body replay space independently of call-ID spelling; matching context remains native-validated, and projected or unknown bodies cannot establish exact delivery.

features.title: GitHub model and context benchmark evidence
invariants: Freeze source, profile, task, budget and environment before comparison.
Hidden grader material never enters retrieval or model input.
Unknown cost, tokens and retrieval relevance remain unknown.

features.title: Gateway jobs, source mirror and development tools
invariants: The existing job owns source, execution, authority and publication.
Optional tool configuration never grants extra authority.
Exported source is not automatically model-admitted context.

features.title: Settled Markdown rendering and chat presentation
invariants: Keep privacy-sensitive content out of the shared parsed-document cache.
Retain current layout, font and theme inputs while reusing bounded settled parse results.
Device performance requires a measured device run.

features.title: Typed failure reports and diagnostic capture epochs
invariants: Keep diagnostic values within the shared closed vocabulary and exclude raw source/provider text.
Negotiate capabilities for newly introduced report fields while retaining compatible legacy payloads.
Require VOICE_STREAMING_BACKEND_EVIDENCE_V1 only for emitted new streaming voice enum values; retain ordinary voice V1 payloads and the bounded plain readiness response.
Do not combine observations across recording epochs or infer a historical crash cause without evidence.
Keep one valid aligned unmet-criterion sample and observed total/omission counts ahead of other summaries inside the unchanged diagnostic byte bound; malformed or unknown evidence gains no authority.

features.title: Android emulator acceptance readiness
invariants: Acceptance uses the same pinned emulator action after exact upstream commit/tree/clean-source and source/runtime digest verification removes only its premature MENU unlock. The real launcher/ANR/foreground readiness predicates, API matrix, memory and time limits remain unchanged.

An upstream revision, source digest, tracked or untracked mutation, or unexpected patch shape prevents execution before either target is written. Host command-order tests do not replace actual healthy API34/API36 instrumentation.
